title: Extension by zero and lower shriek of module objects
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, with module objects
$\Mod_{\Lambda_X}$ over $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ ([sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients],
[sk-def-sfb-module-objects]), and write $j^{\Ab}_!\dashv j^*_{\Ab}$
for the extension by zero and the pullback of abelian sheaves along an open immersion
$j\colon U\to X$ ([sk-def-sfb-finite-lower-shriek],
[def-sfb-finite-upper-star] with $\mathcal A=\Ab$).

- *Projection formula.* For $L\in\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)$ and
  $M\in\Sh(U_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)$ the canonical map
  $j^{\Ab}_!(j^*_{\Ab}L\otimes M)\to L\otimes j^{\Ab}_!M$ is an isomorphism
  (tensor product of [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor]).
- *Linear extension by zero.* By the projection formula, $j^{\Ab}_!$ linearizes
  ([sk-def-sfb-transport]) to a functor
  $j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!\colon\Mod_{j^*\Lambda_X}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_X}$, sending $M$ to
  $j^{\Ab}_!M$ with the action
  $\Lambda_X\otimes j^{\Ab}_!M\cong j^{\Ab}_!(j^*\Lambda_X\otimes M)\to j^{\Ab}_!M$;
  it is left adjoint to $\operatorname{mapMod}(j^*_{\Ab})$.
- *Extension by zero.* The extension by zero of module objects is
  $$
  j_!:=j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!\circ\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha_j}\colon
  \Mod_{\Lambda_U}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_X}
  $$
  ([sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars], [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms]). The underlying
  sheaf of $j_!M$ is $j^{\Ab}_!M$; $j_!$ is exact, and $j_!\dashv j^*$ with $j^*$ the
  pullback of module objects ([sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]).
- *Lower shriek.* For a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow{i}\bar X\xrightarrow{g}Y)$
  of a morphism $f\colon X\to Y$, in particular $f=g\circ i$ with $i$ an open immersion and $g$
  proper ([sk-def-nagata-sketch-data]),
  $$
  f^c_!:=g_*\circ i_!\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_X}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_Y},
  $$
  and for $f$ admitting a compactification, $f_!:=f^c_!$ for a chosen compactification
  $c$ of $f$. The underlying sheaf of $f_!M$ is the lower shriek of abelian sheaves
  of $M$ for the same compactification, and $f_!$ is left exact.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-open-projection-formula] to $j,L,M$. Its map is the adjoint of the unit-induced map $j^*_{\Ab}L\otimes M\to j^*_{\Ab}(L\otimes j^{\Ab}_!M)$, hence is precisely the canonical map in the statement, and it is invertible.

Take $j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!$ from [def-sfb-module-linear-open-lower-shriek]. It has the required source and target, action $(\mathrm{projection})^{-1}$ followed by $j^{\Ab}_!$ of the action, underlying functor $j^{\Ab}_!$, and adjunction to $\operatorname{mapMod}(j^*_{\Ab})$. Thus the specified linearization and its adjunction are available for this $\Lambda,j$.

Define $j_!=j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!\circ\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha_j}$ using [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek]. Its statement gives both the underlying sheaf $j^{\Ab}_!M$ and exactness for every commutative condensed ring and open immersion, as required.

Use the adjunction of [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek-adjunction] for this same $\Lambda,j$. Its left functor is the composite in step 3. Its right functor is $\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_j}\circ\operatorname{mapMod}(j^*_{\Ab})=j^*$, including the natural identification $\operatorname{Coext}_{\alpha_j}\cong\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_j}$ stated there. Hence it supplies exactly $j_!\dashv j^*$.

For the specified compactification $c=(i,g)$ define $f^c_!=g_*\circ i_!$ by [def-sfb-module-compactification-lower-shriek]. The target of $i_!$ and source of $g_*$ are both $\Mod_{\Lambda_{\bar X}}$, so the composite has the stated type. The compactification includes quasi-compactness of $i$ as required by the cited definition.

Choose a compactification $c$ and set $f_!=f^c_!$ by [def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]. That node asserts that its underlying functor is $g^{\Ab}_*\circ i^{\Ab}_!$ for this same $c$, and that $f_!$ is additive and left exact. These give the final two assertions with no comparison of different compactifications.

lean.statement:
noncomputable def lowerShriek :
    Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X) ⥤
      Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y)
lean.note: Exact aggregate match in the published pro-etale ModuleObject framework, confirmed with scompile.py --source. The listed declarations give the canonical open projection formula, its linearization and lifted adjunction, restriction along condensedPullbackHom followed by linear extension by zero, the underlying-sheaf identity, exactness and adjunction to the existing upperStar, compactificationLowerShriek, the chosen lowerShriek, its underlying-sheaf identity and left exactness. For the recorded BoundaryCompactification c, use c.obj.obj as the existing compactification; quasi-compactness is retained by its object property. Existence of a quasi-compact compactification makes f quasi-compact, so every upstream compactification of f, including the chosen one, has quasi-compact open part by Compactification.quasiCompact_openImmersion_iff. The slopmaster2 label denotes the published WeilConjectures source root, including the side-overlay framework; no duplicate construction or proof-closure assertion is introduced.
